summary: Improve first-attempt WhatsApp vault gesture recognition and discreet feedback.

changes.title: One-stroke recognition
changes.detail: Preserves final touch samples and supports small wrist-angle differences using the existing two-of-three enrollment consensus. Existing saved gestures and privacy guards remain.

changes.title: Discreet vault feedback
changes.detail: A failed gesture vibrates without displaying a vault-identifying toast; success confirmation remains haptic. WhatsApp Search keeps its private microphone policy.
